bpmn:process.name: Manual Inventory Adjustment
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Sources: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md (all 43 bounded scopes and reuse rules); Chapters/Kitchen406 - Capstone Paper.md SRS 4.12 FR-INV-15-18, inventory interfaces, FR-STAFF-04-05, NFR-SEC-03,08, NFR-USE-03 and NFR-REL-03,05; index.html and its linked app/inventory-state.js I.change/I.move, app/owner-inventory.js openStock and app/staff-ui.js stockForm. Existing docs XML reviewed for process scopes and DI conventions. BPMN-24 provides the matching vertical layout convention; inventory-control.bpmn.xml is a broad predecessor containing this adjustment flow, monitoring and reservation retry, so invoking it would duplicate this scope. No other XML is changed. Authentication is a precondition (Refer to BPMN-30); check authorization at submission. BPMN-24 owns restocking and is not invoked for a discrepancy. A post-commit signal references independent BPMN-27 monitoring without duplicating its rules or waiting for notification delivery. BPMN-27 and 30 currently have catalog scopes but no bounded XML, so no unresolved calledElement or empty reference process is introduced. Roles share a pool; cross-lane interactions use sequence flows, not message flows. This is a descriptive non-executable proposed process. One submission ends with a traceable adjustment or an unchanged/rejected/failed outcome; correction or retry starts another attempt.

bpmn:startEvent.name: Physical / recorded stock discrepancy found
bpmn:startEvent.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-15. Admin/Owner or authorized Staff identifies a discrepancy, including a correction to an earlier adjustment. Authentication is a precondition: Refer to BPMN-30.

bpmn:userTask.name: Select ingredient; review stock, unit and history
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: Review recorded physical, reserved and available quantities and movement history. A correction of an earlier adjustment is a new movement, retaining the original history.

bpmn:userTask.name: Submit physical count, mandatory reason and optional notes
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-15-16. Enter actual physical count in a supported unit, not a signed amount to add. Preview the resulting signed stock change. Reasons: spoilage, damage, miscount, theft, correction, or another specified reason. Describe Other in notes. A correction may note the original movement reference. Prevent repeated submissions while saving; closing before submission changes nothing.

bpmn:businessRuleTask.name: Validate access, count, unit, reason and discrepancy
bpmn:businessRuleTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-15-16,18. Recheck operational authorization and ingredient existence. Normalize compatible units; require finite nonnegative physical count (zero allowed), up to three base-unit decimals or whole pieces, matching the prototype. Require a supported reason; another reason must be specified. Compute signed delta = counted physical stock minus current recorded physical stock. An unchanged count is rejected without a movement. The proposed Other explanation and count preview follow the SRS even where prototype forms are less explicit. Check request identity: identical saved requests return their recorded result; conflicting reuse is rejected.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Valid correction?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: No includes unauthorized access, invalid input, missing reason, unspecified Other reason, conflicting request identity or unchanged physical count. No stock or ledger changes on rejection.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Show validation issue or unchanged-count message
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Explain the issue and retain input for correction. A matching physical count needs no adjustment. Denied access requires appropriate authorization; BPMN-30 owns authentication recovery.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Not applied; stock unchanged
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: No new movement. The operator can correct input and submit another attempt.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save physical count and justified adjustment movement
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-15-18. Save counted quantity as physical stock and record adjustment movement together: ingredient, signed delta, before and after quantities, unit, mandatory reason, optional notes, timestamp and responsible account. Recalculate delta against stock at commit. Preserve original movements; a correction adds a separate movement. Preserve ingredient unit cost and existing reservations; adjustment does not represent reserved-stock consumption or automatically cancel paid orders. Physical count may be below reserved quantity: retain the discrepancy and commitments for monitoring rather than reject a true count or erase reservations. Preserve prior stock and ledger on failed combined update. Identical already-saved requests return their existing result without a second movement.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Save successful?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Yes includes a safely retrieved already-saved result. Failed saves preserve prior stock and movement history without partial changes.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Show save failure; retain input for safe retry
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Retry with the same operation identity and check the saved result after an uncertain response. Do not create another adjustment for an already recorded request.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Not recorded; retry available
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: No partial stock or movement update. A retry is another attempt using the same request identity.

bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent.name: Stock changed: Refer to BPMN-27
bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent.bpmn:documentation: After a new commit, signal BPMN-27 ? Low-Stock Monitoring and Product Availability Control independently. That process owns threshold evaluation, owner alerts and affected new-order availability. Do not repeat notification delivery, cancel paid orders or wait for alerts here. Retrieving an already-recorded result does not emit duplicate effects.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Display updated quantities and adjustment history
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Show saved physical, reserved and available stock and the traceable movement with signed change, reason and responsible account.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Justified adjustment recorded
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-15-18 satisfied. A physical-count correction is complete; it does not reserve stock, start production or receive new supplies.

bpmn:textAnnotation.bpmn:text: Separate catalog processes: BPMN-30: authentication precondition. BPMN-24: receiving / restocking. BPMN-27: monitoring after stock change. Corrections create new movements; original history remains. Reservations remain distinct from physical stock.
